entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The blue-black guild of Ravnica devoted to secrecy, manipulation and information brokering, long hidden from the public.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The ancient vampire who founded House Dimir, signed the Guildpact, and was exposed and arrested by Agrus Kos; later a spirit controlling Agyrem.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster who purged infiltrators, pledged to oppose Bolas and fought in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: The Azorius arrester who arrested Szadek, breaking the Guildpact's spell.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A figure Szadek manipulated into killing Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild Szadek manipulated into killing Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: The Selesnya guild's collective consciousness, killed through Szadek's manipulation.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: Took control of the lupus to attack and defeat Szadek.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild that imprisoned and secretly executed Szadek.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical contract binding Ravnica's guilds, whose flaw about the Dimir's secrecy let it be broken.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon whose schemes threatened House Dimir's existence.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker sent with Lazav to shut off the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The guardian of the Immortal Sun, blinded by Lazav.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact guarded by Dovin Baan that the team disabled during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Led the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon resurrected with the power of the Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: A district that reappeared in Ravnica under Szadek's control.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle against Nicol Bolas in which Lazav took part.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city where House Dimir operates.

events.summary: The vampire Szadek founds House Dimir and signs the Guildpact as one of the ten paruns.
events.quote: House Dimir was founded by the ancient vampire Szadek

events.summary: Agrus Kos arrests Szadek, breaking the Guildpact's spell and exposing Szadek and House Dimir to the public.
events.quote: The Guildpact's spell was finally broken when Agrus Kos arrested Szadek, which exposed him and House Dimir to the public.

events.summary: Szadek manipulates Savra and the Selesnya Conclave into killing Mat'Selesnya.
events.quote: manipulating Savra and the Selesnya Conclave to do his bidding and kill Mat'Selesnya

events.summary: Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack Szadek, defeating him.
events.quote: He is ultimately defeated when Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack him.

events.summary: Szadek is arrested by Agrus Kos and imprisoned by the Azorius, who secretly execute him.
events.quote: imprisoned by the Azorius who secretly executes him

events.summary: A new Guildpact does not recognize House Dimir, but the district of Agyrem reappears under the spirit Szadek's control.
events.quote: the district of Agyrem reappeared within Ravnica

events.summary: Lazav finds and kills the infiltrators in his guild and pledges the Dimir to the alliance opposing Bolas.
events.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas

events.summary: Lazav disguises himself as Chandra so the real Chandra can disable the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Lazav disguised himself as Chandra, which allowed the real Chandra to disable the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Lazav defeats Dovin Baan, leaving him blinded and forcing him to planeswalk away.
events.quote: Lazav defeated Dovin and left him blinded, forcing him to planeswalk away

events.summary: Lazav and the other guildmasters join Nissa's ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet with the power of the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Lazav participated in a ritual led by Nissa to resurrect Niv-Mizzet and grant him the power of the Living Guildpact

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion the Dimir stage the elimination of their entire leadership with eyewitnesses and evidence to fade from public notice.
events.quote: they staged the elimination of their entire leadership, complete with eyewitnesses and overwhelming physical evidence

relations.quote: House Dimir was founded by the ancient vampire Szadek
remained in charge of the guild for the subsequent 10,000 years

relations.note: Guildmaster in the Return to Ravnica era onward.
relations.quote: Lazav managed to find and kill the infiltrators in his guild
He is ultimately defeated when Jarad takes control of the lupus and forces them to attack him.

relations.note: Worked together against the Immortal Sun.
relations.quote: Lazav disguised himself as Chandra, which allowed the real Chandra to disable the Immortal Sun
Lazav defeated Dovin and left him blinded, forcing him to planeswalk away

relations.note: Pledged to the alliance against Bolas.
relations.quote: he pledged his guild to the alliance that planned to oppose Bolas
